steps.text: Rows of pachinko machines are laid out in a room of modest size. The sounds of buttons being pressed and explosion sound effects can be heard from inside.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: New customer?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: All the machines are on. Just put a coin in. Help yourself to drinks and snacks at the counter—

steps.name: Cool-Headed Yakuza
steps.text: Are you Kichisei?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Uh, you're not here for pachinko?

steps.name: Cool-Headed Yakuza
steps.text: We heard about your side hustle, and we'd like to ask for some help.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: *sigh* Side hustle? No idea what you mean. I think you've got the wrong girl...

steps.name: Cool-Headed Yakuza
steps.text: Our boss just got a bunch of gems in from Sargon. We want you to take a look... here's the offer.
The yakuza gestures a number with his hand.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: (Gulps) ...For real?

steps.name: Cool-Headed Yakuza
steps.text: For real.

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: Welcome, Kichisei-san.

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: The Yamakawa-kai is new in Mitsukue, and we could use a local to help us expand into the market.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Skip the preamble. Where are the goods?
The yakuza boss waves his hand, and a heavy briefcase is placed on the table.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: So many...?!

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: Natural gems that I obtained from a friend. One would have a hard time finding a better collection in all Higashi.

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: I obtained these gems at considerable expense, but moving them is a challenge...

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: To put all these treasures on the market at once would not only depreciate their value, but also draw unwanted attention.

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: I've heard of your appraisal skills and connections in Mitsukue. I'm confident you will be able to find the right buyers for me.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Wait up, I haven't agreed to take the job yet!
Kichisei picks up a red gem and examines it under the ceiling light.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: It looks good at first glance. However...

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: ...However?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Sargon makes great gems, but it's mostly small workshops with low production rates.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: You have a lot of different types here, but the cuts are similar across the board.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Too regular. No change of tools. The people who made this batch were novices.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Look at the corners here. Looks too new. Best-case scenario, it's a new batch. Worst-case scenario... the materials may not have been natural.

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: Impossible... impossible!

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: I watched them take each piece out of the auction house's storage and picked them one by one!

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: *sigh* If you don't believe me... look at this one.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: There's a sapphire identical to this in the Varjavandabad Museum called 'Tear of Splendor', with the same tear-shaped gold piece inlaid on it.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Did you think a Sargonian national treasure could have ended up in this place through a regular auction house?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: ...Do I need to say any more?

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: You mean... all these treasures... they're fake?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Yes, any appraiser worth her salt would tell you.

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: ...But all of these have been certified by experts.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: They came to me by way of a legislator whose name is known to all Higashinese collectors.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: You mean Toudou—

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: Do not say the name!

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: He had these gems examined by appraisal agencies before he gave it to me. These certifications were issued by experts.
The boss lays a heavy pile of documents on the table, printed with the logos of various institutions.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: (Mutters) Kuso, not people you want to get on the wrong side of...

spans.text: , not people you want to get on the wrong side of...

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: As you can see, not one expert says my treasures are fake. Except you.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: ...Why come to me, if you've already had such an authoritative appraisal?

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: Like I said at the beginning, Kichisei-san, I would like you to find me some good buyers.

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: My men have looked into it. Your grandmother was a beacon of Mitsukue's jewelry world, and you took over her business.

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: I am confident that you will be able to move them, and I assure you that you will be well-compensated for your efforts.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Heh... you've gotta be joking. I'm just a pachinko parlor girl.

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: ...You don't want to help me because you think my goods are fake.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: What are you talking about? I never said that.

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: (Gestures)

steps.name: Cool-Headed Yakuza
steps.text: Yes, boss, I got it all on tape.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: ...You set me up?!

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: Only basic due diligence.

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: I have faith in your abilities, Kichisei-san.

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: I spent my entire fortune to get these goods from the legislator. If you think they're all fake, I'll settle the score with him, with your report in hand...

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: If they're good... then you'll help me get it sold, all of it, for the billions it's worth.

steps.name: Confused Resident
steps.text: Do you know where Kichisei is?

steps.name: Confused Resident
steps.text: The pachinko shop's closed, and there's no sign on the door...

steps.name: Perplexed Resident
steps.text: Something must have come up, I guess? She's a busy girl.

steps.name: Confused Resident
steps.text: No cheap pachinko today, I guess. Can't go to other places once you get used to her prices...

steps.name: Confused Resident
steps.text: Kichisei! Welcome back!

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Perplexed Resident
steps.text: Why the long face?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Hmm... it's all my bloody fault. I should have never gotten involved in this!

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Never should have had anything to do with those people... now I either have to sell billions in fake goods, or owe them billions!

steps.name: Confused Resident & Perplexed Resident
steps.text: B-Billions?!

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: I couldn't pay it even if I sold the shop... heck, not even if I sold myself!
Kichisei staggers towards her shop, tapping her own head, leaving behind the dumbfounded passersby.
As night falls, the neon sign of the Lucky Star blinks irregularly, seemingly ready to go out at any minute.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Kichisei, Kichisei... what's with you and your unlucky stars?

steps.name: Cool-Headed Yakuza
steps.text: She's home, boss.

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: What did she do?

steps.name: Cool-Headed Yakuza
steps.text: Nothing... she cried for a while with a pillow in her arms, rolled around on the ground a while, and she's now playing video games.

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: ...She didn't call anyone?

steps.name: Cool-Headed Yakuza
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Cool-Headed Yakuza
steps.text: Boss, are you sure she's the one we're looking for? She doesn't have anything at home except game machines, and she doesn't look rich at all...

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: That's impossible!

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: Her grandmother made so much selling fake jewelry. How could she not leave any for her granddaughter?

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: She was like this when we scouted her out, wasting away most of her days. That means she's not short of money.

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: I'm not about to let a big fin like this slip away!

steps.name: Cool-Headed Yakuza
steps.text: Hello? Yes... what?

steps.name: Cool-Headed Yakuza
steps.text: ...Got it.

steps.name: Cool-Headed Yakuza
steps.text: Boss, the informant says she's packing her stuff!

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: Hmph, I knew it... keep a close eye on her. Don't let her get away.

steps.name: Friendly Stall Owner
steps.text: Everyday items, accessories, snacks, all half-price—

steps.name: Friendly Stall Owner
steps.text: Hey, Kichisei! What's with that huge rucksack on your back?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: I came to say good-bye, Suzuki ji-san... I think I may have to leave Kajimachi for a while.

steps.name: Suzuki
steps.text: What's the matter all of a sudden?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: I-It's nothing. It's just... well, I guess I'm taking my business elsewhere.

steps.name: Suzuki
steps.text: What business could you be in such a hurry about...? Don't tell me you ran into trouble?

steps.name: Suzuki
steps.text: You can just say it. We've known each other for so long, I'll help however I can.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: (Glances about) Well... I guess there's a fair bit of trouble, alright. But it's my problem and I don't want to drag anyone else into it.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Anyway, this is what happened...

steps.name: Sad Stall Owner
steps.text: I'm so sad about this, Kichisei-chan...

steps.name: Sad Stall Owner
steps.text: Your grandma was good to me, and we've been like sisters to each other all these years. And now you're just packing up and leaving?

steps.name: Sad Stall Owner
steps.text: What's gonna happen to your shop...?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Old Man Tessai owns the shop, he'll find someone to take care of it.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: It's a good location. There'll be a tenant interested in the second-floor shop. Maybe a video shop, or a ramen shop...

steps.name: Sad Stall Owner
steps.text: (Sob) That's enough, Kichisei-chan... I don't want anyone else to open shop here. I just want you to stay here in Kajimachi...

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: B-But... I've gotta go, nee-chan.

steps.name: Angry Stall Owner
steps.text: So sudden? At least let us hold a party for you to see you off. I'll let the others know.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: (Glances around) N-No, there's no need! I'm leaving tomorrow and I don't want to bother people.

steps.name: Cool-Headed Yakuza
steps.text: Kichisei has been out all day, saying goodbye to her neighbors.

steps.name: Cool-Headed Yakuza
steps.text: She noticed me from the beginning and didn't say anything about the appraisal or debt.

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: Hmph. Knew it. She's got zero cards to play.

steps.name: Cool-Headed Yakuza
steps.text: Maybe... she's setting herself up to borrow money.

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: From a bunch of hawkers on a run-down street?

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: Let's see how long she can hide...
...Enough cards for today. Not in the mood.
You all know about Kichisei?
She was practically in tears when she came around to say goodbye in the morning. Made my heart hurt...
Any idea who's behind it?
There were a few unfamiliar faces who had been tailing her. Didn't look like honest folk.
I told Takahashi and Watanabe to follow them when I closed the stall, and try to find out more.
Good. I'll get some old friends.
Ah, you're gonna do it?
Did you forget the oath we swore to Tessai? We washed our hands of all this stuff in exchange for a peaceful existence on this street for the rest of our lives—
Tessai's got his hands full with his number two right now. He might not be able to help the girl even if he wanted to.
Besides, she's OUR little girl. How do we look into each other's eyes at this card table again if we don't do anything for her?
...You're right. All these years of peace and quiet have made me senile...
Enough talk. Let's get to work.
So—how did you end up still staying here at the shop?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: It was weird. I had all my stuff packed and was ready to say goodbye to Old Man Tessai, when I found those yakuza standing at my door just as I was about to leave...

steps.name: Yakuza Boss & Fearful Yakuza
steps.text: (Deep bow) We're very sorry!

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: (Staying bowed) We really apologize for our rudeness! We didn't know you had ties to Isazaki's Shochiku-kai!

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Huh? What's that?

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: We understand our mistake now! Please, have mercy on us!

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: Please accept this token of our apology, Kichisei-sama!

steps.name: Yakuza Boss
steps.text: (Bows even deeper) Again, we're really, really sorry!

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Not only did I not have to pay a single mon, I made a fair bit of money in appraisal fees... amazing, isn't it?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: It's an interesting story, alright... do you want me to look into who took care of it for you?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Nah, no point bringing everything into the open.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: The kind soul who helped me never revealed themselves. That means they don't want people to know who they are.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Besides, maybe it's my good luck—see this 'Great Blessing' omikuji I just got at the shrine?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Well, that's a healthy frame of mind to be in.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Hey, life's not so bad, is it? I was thinking how great it would be if I could stay at this shop for the rest of my life.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: *sigh* I envy you. I wish I had inherited a huge amount of money too...

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Who said I inherited a bunch of money?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Grandma always said 'Life's short, enjoy it while it lasts.' She would take me out on trips whenever she made any money.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Come to think of it, we could hardly even afford to eat whenever we came back from one of those trips...

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: (Wipes sweat) *sigh* Now I know where you got your habits from. Good thing you folks didn't give this shop up...

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Of course we wouldn't give this shop up. It's our only home, and we'd have no roof above our heads if we gave it up! I know that much, at least.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Looks like we've got a customer! All the machines are on. Just put a coin in. Help yourself to drinks and snacks at the counter—
